notes.title: Since the release of Ground Zero a little under a month ago, we have been blown away by your support - it has not gone unnoticed! Every bug report and piece of feedback has been crucial in the post launch period.

items.text: So, without further ado, we present to you the patch notes of the most recent update:
May Patch Updates
All Platforms
Added the ability to delete old save files directly from the in-game Save Menu, this should also resolve a rare progression issue reported on PlayStation 5.
Resolved multiple crash instances, including a rare issue during the final boss encounter and during specific enemy executions.
Addressed a progression issue involving the Police Station gate.
Fixed an issue where inventory menus would unintentionally unpause the game.
Addressed multiple visual, audio, and collision issues in Chapter 11 to ensure smoother progression.
Restored the correct texture for the Zodiac Coin Case.
Fixed minor UI issues regarding the downscaling slider and FPS cap persistence.
Xbox Specific
Fixed a specific targeting issue encountered during the final boss fight.
We just wanted to let you all know that, alongside the larger patch we released earlier this week, we've released a small hotfix for our demo.

notes.title: Here's what is included in this hotfix

items.text: Made sure the player can't accidentally scan bodies during combat
Fixed an issue where an item safe was unsolvable
Made sure the player can't close the inventory accidentally if you open it while holding run on controller
Made sure you can't accidentally execute enemies on controller while trying to shoot
To prevent players from accidentally skipping cutscenes, you now need to hold the "Interact" button to skip cutscenes, which is E on keyboard and (A) on controller

notes.title: Thank you so much again to everyone who has taken the time to give feedback on our demo and provide bug reports!

items.text: If you have any more bug reports or feedback you'd like to share, we'd love to hear from you in the Steam Forums or in our Discord!

notes.title: We’ve been hard at work post launch to ensure your player experience is the best it can be.

items.text: Following the release of Ground Zero, we’ve been addressing community feedback alongside adding a plethora of quality of life features that are included in the 27th April patch. You can expect significant performance improvements as well as framerate caps, individual save deletion, and much more.
Added the option in Video settings to set max framerate on PC to reduce GPU consumption.
Significant performance improvements.
Video settings are fully available when using gamepad on PC.
Saves can now be individually deleted.
Certain enemies no longer fail to move at very high framerates.
Additional game difficulties now correctly unlock after beating the game in Easy and Normal.
Reworked boat controls in Modern scheme, which now uses forward/reverse buttons.
Player can no longer prematurely leave the Chapter 10 boss fight arena.
Multiple weapon projectiles are now properly aligned.
One unlockable weapon can no longer incorrectly trigger an environmental hazard in Chapter 8.
Certain enemies are no longer immune to damage from a certain unlockable weapon.
Trees are now correctly textured in one of the endings.
You no longer need to hold a button to open your map, and instead you can long hold for pause menu as it's less commonly accessed.
You may need to rebind your inventory, map and pause buttons.
We hugely appreciate the continued support of the community, with the bug reports in particular having been pivotal in allowing us to resolve these issues swiftly.
